# Networking Engineering

From network foundations to architecture, troubleshooting and engineering—supported by practical labs.

::: {.nf-outcome .nf-ui}
**Before you begin:** this path assumes Level 0 foundations: files, operating systems, browsers, local networks and terminals. Start with [Computer Foundations](../foundations/index.qmd) if any of these are new. Weeks 1–2 contain full lessons and labs; Weeks 3–8 are currently structured engineering outlines, not substitutes for a complete lesson.

Use the [Technical Glossary](../glossary.qmd) to review terminology. Recommended concept order: data → local network → Ethernet → MAC/ARP → IP → router → DNS/DHCP.
:::
